verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an 'Advanced search' that filters items by many properties, and its API can list items filtered by level and environment (e.g., production). Nothing shows a real query syntax, search across projects, or filtering by tag, release, or custom properties. Missing for 10: documented query syntax, cross-project search, tag/release/custom-property filters, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and filter events across projects by tag, release, environment, and custom properties with a real query syntax

citations.quote: Advanced search: Filter items by many different properties.
